clips.title: The story
paras: Rethban Caverns wind through the northwestern cliffs of the Redridge Mountains. Aggressive Redridge gnolls infest this extensive cave system, the only source of uncommon Rethban ore.

Deep in the northwestern mountains above Lake Everstill, Rethban Caverns shelter the local gnolls as a fortified redoubt. Their cunning leader, Ardo Dirtpaw, commands a pack that fiercely guards the twisting passages and chambers below. Wanderers who stray too close to the hillside entrance face attack.

Rethban ore is a distinct mineral found in these winding, dangerous tunnels and carried by the Dirtpaw pack. Blacksmiths and researchers in Lakeshire often send travelers into the caverns to recover samples of this rare mountain ore.
